Animal physiotherapy or rehabilitation is an important component of the treatment for many musculoskeletal (muscle, bone, joints, soft tissues) and neurological conditions seen in dogs, cats, rabbits and exotic pets.

Dr Jane McNae, owner of Paws in Motion, Veterinary Physiotherapy, is both an experienced Veterinary Surgeon and also Hong Kong’s first Certified Canine Rehabilitation Therapist. Working in Hong Kong for 20 years, she has examined, diagnosed and treated with medicine and surgery all the common conditions your pet may suffer.
